limitations: Native semantics intentionally differ from legacy Python; compatibility uses explicit per-family parameters.
InclusiveDiv capacity is LATENCY. Its input1 is snooped and never consumed; END still consumes dummy input0. Native queue/valid tracking changes cycles.
Native zero division returns all-one quotient and dividend remainder; original scalar Python raises ZeroDivisionError.
MAC remains fixed 16-bit and requires all three predicates/valids for every opcode. Vector-factor metadata does not change its predicate, as in Python.
Public FU reset isolation is not a universal clear/reset redesign of each historical standalone FU.
Combo post-synthesis benches omit only flattened-away private Fu0 counter hierarchy checks; full public outputs and independent math remain.
Component SCC and legal-catalog lint checks do not establish full-system timing, four-state or formal equivalence. System regression is a later task.
Verilator RTL optimization remains enabled; CXXFLAGS=-O0 affects only generated C++ compilation. Internal splitnets eliminates false word-level netlist dependencies.
laboratory_notes: Pre-fix native pipeline CYCLE=3 produced 55555554 for ffffffff/3; pre-fix signed MAC -32768 < 1 produced zero. Maintained native-pass/legacy-fail witnesses are included.
First div32 emitted netlist passed bit SCC but Verilator failed its default convergence limit. splitnets plus opt_clean passed the same functional oracle without raising the limit.
First PE harness reversed command 7 total-steps and command 8 count-per-iteration; corrected before final complete matrix.
The legacy vector PE probe also passes: outer PE step/output gating masks the standalone FU early-ready defect. It is recorded as a positive compatibility probe.
A broad old ac96 scalar bench was unsuitable for current Grant/GEP semantics; dedicated current Python divider/LoopControl replay and unchanged LoopCounter vectors are used instead.
The MAC vector counter is unused by its output predicate. A proposed counter semantic change was discarded; added tests retain the original three-input predicate behavior.
Invalid DATA_W=64 may report the inner native divider guard before the legacy wrapper guard; the negative harness accepts either relevant parameter diagnostic.
